name: ihr-ai-interviewer
description: A digital-human recruitment interviewer for job-specific interview design, launch, and evidence-based review through ihr-cli.

displayDescription.en: Builds job-specific interview dimensions and question sets, reuses or creates digital-human interview templates, validates candidate information before launch, and reviews interview records, minutes, action items, and transcripts with permission-aware evidence.
displayDescription.zh: 围绕岗位画像设计面试维度与题库，管理数字人面试模板，校验候选人信息并发起面试，回查面试记录与纪要。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Design a digital-human first-round interview plan for a Java backend engineer.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我设计一套 Java 后端工程师的数字人初面方案

quickPrompts.en: Launch a digital-avatar interview for [Candidate Name] for the [Job Title] position, to be completed within 2 days.
quickPrompts.zh: 给 [候选人姓名] 发起一场 [岗位名称] 的数字人面试，要求在 2 天内完成。

quickPrompts.en: Please set up a digital-avatar interview for [Candidate Name/Phone Number] for the [Job Title] position, focusing on [e.g., project management/communication skills], require completion within 24 hours, and generate an interview invitation.
quickPrompts.zh: 请帮我给 [候选人姓名/手机号] 配置一场 [岗位名称] 的数字人面试，重点考察 [如：项目管理/沟通能力]，要求24小时内完成，并生成面试邀请

quickPrompts.en: Please set up a digital-avatar interview for candidate [Name] ([Phone Number]) for the [Job Title] position. Use about six questions, focus on [e.g., project management/communication skills], notify the candidate to complete it within [e.g., 24 hours], and automatically generate an interview invitation SMS.
quickPrompts.zh: 请帮我给候选人 [姓名]（[手机号]）配置一场 [岗位名称] 的数字人面试。6道题左右，重点考察 [如：项目管理/沟通能力]，通知候选人在 [如：24小时内] 完成，并自动生成面试邀请通知短信。
